第38章 第二次上山打猎-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

分开的时候，李青山顺便叮嘱了一下大壮，明天上午的时候进山，这才东西带的多，可以在山上多呆一段时间，而且装备也都买的齐全了。

李青山回到家后，冲了个凉水澡！

刚准备回房间睡觉，便听到有人用木棍敲墙，李青山眉头紧皱，这大晚上的谁啊？

胆子这么大？

敢来敲我李青山的墙？

还让不让人睡觉的？

李青山穿好鞋走了出去，看着还在敲墙的黑影道：“谁啊，大晚上的让不让人睡觉了？”

黑影听到李青山的声音后，便停了下来。

掀掉盖在头上的头巾道：“青山，是我，柔雪！”

柔雪？

李青山微微一怔，想起了白天那个风韵犹存，书香气质的小寡妇柔雪。

大半夜的，她来找自己做什么？

就在李青山疑惑之际，一个念头突然蹦了出来。

这女人白天说的话，不会是在真的吧？

“柔雪，你想好了？”李青山走了过去，望着浑身上下充斥着书香气息，身段娇小玲珑的柔雪问道。

柔雪的身上，自带着书香的气息。

主要是体现在气质上，与石溪村的村民完全不同，特别是柔雪和石溪村的村民站在一起的时候，就像是鹤立鸡群。

风韵犹存加上书香气息。

就是极品小寡妇。

柔雪不高，大概也就一米五出头，连一米五五都没有到，可以说是极其娇小的女人。

因为常年吃不饱饭的原因，身段也极其瘦弱。

李青山估测！

柔雪现在也就六十多斤，自己一只手都能将其抱起来，也不知道能不能承受的住自己。

“想好了！”

“青山，我想要你。”

柔雪主动靠了过来，美眸之中动了情，一脸期待紧张的望着李青山道。

这一刻。

李青山望着怀中头顶只到自己胸口的柔雪，能够清晰察觉到，柔雪的身子都在颤抖。

二人都是干柴烈火。

一点就燃。

“走，去我房间！”

Chapter 38 The second time to hunt in the mountains - "Mountain Hunting 1957: Two pounds of pork in exchange for a wife"

When they were separated, Li Qingshan told Da Zhuang to go into the mountain tomorrow morning. Now that he had brought more things, he could stay in the mountain for a longer period of time, and he also bought all the equipment.

After Li Qingshan returned home, he took a cold shower!

Just as he was about to go back to his room to sleep, he heard someone knocking on the wall with a wooden stick. Li Qingshan frowned. Who was this late at night?

So brave?

Dare you come and knock on my, Li Qingshan’s wall?

And not letting people sleep?

Li Qingshan put on his shoes and walked out. He looked at the black figure who was still knocking on the wall and said, "Who is it? Isn't it so late at night that no one can sleep?"

The black shadow stopped after hearing Li Qingshan's voice.

He took off the scarf covering his head and said: "Qingshan, it's me, Rouxue!"

Rouxue?

Li Qingshan was slightly startled, remembering the young widow Rouxue who still had a charming and scholarly temperament during the day.

Why did she come to see him in the middle of the night?

Just when Li Qingshan was confused, an idea suddenly popped out.

What this woman said during the day could not be true, could it?

"Rou Xue, have you made up your mind?" Li Qingshan walked over and asked looking at Rou Xue, who was filled with the fragrance of books and had a petite figure.

Rouxue has a scholarly aura about her body.

Mainly in terms of temperament, it is completely different from the villagers of Shixi Village. Especially when Rouxue and the villagers of Shixi Village stand together, she looks like she stands out from the crowd.

The charm is still there with the scent of books.

She is the ultimate little widow.

Rouxue is not tall, only about 1.5 meters tall, not even 1.55 meters tall. She can be said to be an extremely petite woman.

Because he didn't have enough to eat all year round, he was extremely thin.

Li Qingshan estimates!

Rouxue only weighs more than sixty pounds now. I can hold her up with one hand, but I don't know if she can bear it.

"Think about it!"

"Qingshan, I want you."

Rouxue took the initiative to come closer, her beautiful eyes moved with emotion, and she looked at Li Qingshan nervously and expectantly.

This moment.

Li Qingshan looked at Rouxue in his arms, whose head only reached his chest, and could clearly feel that Rouxue's body was trembling.

Both of them are like firewood.

It burns at once.

"Let's go to my room!"
